description: The bar chart compares the ratio of knowledge popularity among three different language models: Llama3, Qwen2, and ChatGPT, across three categories: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The vertical axis represents the ratio, labeled as "Ratio (%)", and is linear, ranging from 50 to 90 in increments of 10. The horizontal axis lists the categories. In the Movies category, Llama3 has the highest ratio, close to 90%, followed by Qwen2 with a ratio slightly above 80%, and ChatGPT with a ratio around 70%. In the Songs category, Qwen2 leads with a ratio just below 90%, Llama3 follows with a ratio around 80%, and ChatGPT has the lowest ratio, approximately 60%. In the Basketball category, Llama3 has the highest ratio, around 70%, Qwen2 has a ratio just above 60%, and ChatGPT has the lowest ratio, close to 50%. The bars are color-coded with Llama3 in blue, Qwen2 in red, and ChatGPT in yellow. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on the bars.
